journalisticStructure.framework: Evidence-led buyer guide with human review

sections.title: Buyer dilemma
sections.requiredContent: State the decision and evidence status without declaring an unsupported winner.

sections.title: Decision criteria
sections.requiredContent: Compare documented features and meaningful trade-offs.

sections.title: Evidence ledger
sections.requiredContent: List source URL, title and access date for each external claim.

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
sections.requiredContent: Answer only questions supported by the evidence.

eeatTestingProtocol.hoursOfBenchTesting: Only when original records are attached

monetizationAndCompliance.ftcDisclosureText: Transparência Editorial: Avaliações 100% independentes. Compras pelos links oficiais apoiam nossos testes sem custo adicional ao leitor.

feedbackSummary.source: anonymous article feedback; not used as factual evidence

learningGuardrails: Feedback changes structure and prioritization only.
Feedback never creates product facts, ratings, prices, tests or winners.
A human editor must approve evidence before publication.
